summary: Replace pre-production schema 0.1 with **modelo v0.2** on `:server`: SQLDelight `.sqm` → Flyway SQL, `OrgRole` + holders, Google OIDC/session tables, `stored_files`, `version` optimistic locking, strict position constraints, `MemberStatus.deleted`, and seeds §12.1–12.2. **Server only**.
overview:
Second platform slice after (or parallel to) `platform-server-infra`. Aligns SQLite with `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.5, §5 (v0.2), §6.9 (`stored_files`), §12.1–12.2 (seed data), and `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Migration policy (greenfield pre-production)**
- No production data yet → **replace** `V1__initial_schema.sqm` (0.1) with the v0.2 baseline DDL plus `V2__seed.sqm`.
- Once deployed to production, never edit applied migrations — add `V3__…` onwards.
- Developers with an old local DB delete `DB_PATH` before starting the server (noted in `Database.kt` KDoc).
- Pipeline: edit `.sqm` → `./gradlew :server:generateMainTabalaDatabaseMigrations` → Flyway applies generated `db/migration/*.sql` at runtime.

**Key v0.2 + `decisiones.md` schema rules**
- `users.status` CHECK: `('active', 'inactive', 'on_leave', 'deleted')` (`deleted` replaces `former`). `height_cm CHECK (height_cm BETWEEN 50 AND 250)`. Add `preferred_locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ca' CHECK (preferred_locale IN ('ca', 'es'))`. Drop `board_role`, `board_role_since`. Add `version`.
- `areas`: add `kind ('board', 'area')` with unique partial index `WHERE kind = 'board'`; make `slug NOT NULL UNIQUE`; keep optional `meeting_frequency IN ('weekly', 'biweekly', 'monthly', 'as_needed')`; drop `goals`; add `version`.
- `inventory_items`: add supplier reorder & sales columns (`supplier_contact TEXT`, `supplier_reference TEXT`, `min_order_qty INTEGER CHECK (min_order_qty >= 0)`, `lead_time TEXT`, `last_ordered_at TEXT`, `units_sold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (units_sold >= 0)`, `revenue_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revenue_cents >= 0)`) and `version`.
- Organigrama: add `org_roles` (`area_id REFERENCES areas(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`, `UNIQUE(area_id, name)`, `version`) and `org_role_holders` (`PRIMARY KEY(org_role_id, user_id)`, FK `ON DELETE CASCADE`); drop `area_members`.
- Auth (§4.5): `user_accounts` drops `auth_provider` and `auth_uid` (no Firebase); add `google_identities`, `sessions`, `refresh_tokens`. Invariant (`status != 'invited' => google_identities row exists`) enforced in `AccountLinkingService` transaction.
- `events`: `category NOT NULL`, `status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned'`, `version`.
- `figures` & `positions`: `figures.name UNIQUE`, `positions` adds `UNIQUE (figure_id, x, y, z)` and `CHECK (x BETWEEN -20 AND 20 AND y BETWEEN -20 AND 20 AND z BETWEEN 0 AND 8)`.
- `stored_files` (§6.9): stores metadata + internal `storage_key` (random filename on disk) + optional `thumb_storage_key` (400 px thumbnail); domain media columns become `*_file_id REFERENCES stored_files(id) ON DELETE SET NULL` (and `documents.file_id NOT NULL REFERENCES stored_files(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`, `event_gallery.file_id NOT NULL REFERENCES stored_files(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`).
- `version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` on all mutable entity tables updated via PATCH/PUT: `groups`, `users`, `areas`, `org_roles`, `events`, `contracts`, `inventory_items`, `achievements`, `figures`, `position_types`, `documents`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test` green.
- Fresh DB has Flyway versions **1** (DDL) + **2** (seed).
- Counts: `areas = 8` (1 `board` + 7 `area`), `org_roles = 40`, `position_types = 10`, `groups` with `is_own = 1` = 1 («Muixeranga d'Elx»).
- `google_identities`, `sessions`, `refresh_tokens`, `stored_files` exist.
- No `area_members`, no `board_role*`, no Firebase columns.
- Constraint tests verify `positions` coordinate bounds/uniqueness, single `board` area, `org_roles` `ON DELETE RESTRICT`, `users.status = 'deleted'`, `users.preferred_locale`, and `inventory_items` sales/reorder columns.
shared_ui_policy: No UI and no `:core` DTOs in this slice (`platform-core-contract`).
out_of_scope:
- Ktor routes, repositories, and feature `.sq` query files (added in auth and feature slices).
- `:core` DTOs and enums.
- Auth business logic (`platform-server-auth`) and file upload/download handlers (`platform-files`).
- Real member PII or import scripts.
- Migrating pre-existing v0.1 production databases (none exist).

auth.server: DDL only for `user_accounts`, `google_identities`, `sessions`, and `refresh_tokens` per §4.5. No passwords or Firebase columns.

structure:
Server-only persistence pipeline:

```text
server/src/main/sqldelight/migrations/V1__initial_schema.sqm + V2__seed.sqm
  → ./gradlew :server:generateMainTabalaDatabaseMigrations
  → build/generated/flyway/db/migration/V1__*.sql, V2__*.sql
  → openDatabase() / Flyway.migrate()
  → SQLite WAL (foreign_keys = ON, busy_timeout = 5000)
```

Key table groups in v0.2:
- Identity & auth: `users`, `user_accounts`, `user_guardians`, `google_identities`, `sessions`, `refresh_tokens`
- Organigrama: `areas`, `org_roles`, `org_role_holders`
- Operations: `events`, `event_gallery`, `event_figures`, `event_groups`, `attendance`, `contracts`, `inventory_items`, `inventory_variants`
- Colla & repertoire: `groups`, `achievements`, `figures`, `position_types`, `positions`, `documents`
- Media metadata: `stored_files`

sections.title: stored_files table and media foreign keys (§6.9)
sections.description: `stored_files`: `id TEXT PK`, `owner_type TEXT NOT NULL`, `owner_id TEXT NOT NULL`, `field TEXT NOT NULL`, `original_name TEXT NOT NULL`, `storage_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE`, `thumb_storage_key TEXT`, `content_type TEXT NOT NULL`, `size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0)`, `protected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (protected IN (0, 1))`, `created_at TEXT NOT NULL`.
sections.behavior: Media references across tables become `*_file_id REFERENCES stored_files(id)`: `users.avatar_file_id`, `groups.image_file_id`, `groups.logo_file_id`, `events.image_file_id`, `event_gallery.file_id`, `inventory_items.image_file_id`, `achievements.logo_file_id`, `figures.image_file_id`, `documents.file_id`. Index `stored_files(owner_type, owner_id)` for cleanup.

sections.title: Optimistic locking (`version`) and child tables
sections.description: Add `version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version >= 1)` to every aggregate root updated via PATCH/PUT: `groups`, `users`, `areas`, `org_roles`, `events`, `contracts`, `inventory_items`, `achievements`, `figures`, `position_types`, `documents`.
sections.behavior: Child/join tables (`user_guardians`, `org_role_holders`, `event_gallery`, `event_figures`, `event_groups`, `inventory_variants`, `positions`) inherit versioning from their parent aggregate (for example `PUT /figures/{id}/positions` checks and increments `figures.version`). `attendance` is upserted per `(event_id, user_id)` and does not require client `version`.

sections.title: Seed data (§12.1 and §12.2)
sections.description: Insert 8 `areas` (slugs: `junta`, `tecnica`, `xicalla`, `membres`, `marqueting`, `esdeveniments`, `relacions`, `material`), 40 `org_roles` with exact `is_lead` flags and descriptions for `Legal extern` and `Legal intern`, 1 own `groups` row («Muixeranga d'Elx», «Fem pinya com una tabala», `foundation = 2022`, `is_own = 1`), and 10 `position_types` with ASCII slugs (`mestre`, `bases`, `alcadors`, `contrafort`, `escala`, `mans`, `passador`, `segon`, `terc`, `xicalla`) and Valencian `name` labels.
sections.behavior: Use fixed deterministic UUIDs in `V2__seed.sqm` for areas, org_roles, and own group so tests and references remain reproducible across environments. Never insert `users` or `org_role_holders` in migrations.

sections.title: Constraints updated from v0.1
sections.description: Fix v0.1 gaps discovered against §5: `users.status IN ('active','inactive','on_leave','deleted')`, `users.height_cm BETWEEN 50 AND 250`, `areas.slug NOT NULL UNIQUE`, `areas.kind IN ('board','area')` with unique partial index for `kind = 'board'`, `events.category NOT NULL`, `events.status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned'`, `figures.name NOT NULL UNIQUE`, `positions` `UNIQUE (figure_id, x, y, z)` and `CHECK (x BETWEEN -20 AND 20 AND y BETWEEN -20 AND 20 AND z BETWEEN 0 AND 8)`.
sections.behavior: Keep `documents.event_id REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT` and `documents.user_id REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT` so historical documents are never silently lost; `DELETE /users/{id}` and `anonymize` never physically delete the `users` row (only `admin` `?hard=true` fails with `409 in_use` if documents exist).

persistence: SQLite on `:server` only. Two Flyway migrations (`V1` DDL + `V2` seed) generated from `.sqm`. WAL, `foreign_keys = ON`, and `busy_timeout = 5000` enforced via `DatabaseAccess`.
